accepted_gaps.title: Undeclared continuation from finite data to infinite future
accepted_gaps.testable_form: Require a declared asymptotic-assumption card before any fate class or time integral can be emitted.
accepted_gaps.falsification_condition: If all admissible continuation classes consistent with the observed likelihood yield the same fate category, continuation labeling adds no classification value.

accepted_gaps.title: Conflation of expansion and vacuum-decay endpoints
accepted_gaps.testable_form: Compare a separated two-ledger report with a single end-time report for logical consistency and source-use correctness.
accepted_gaps.falsification_condition: If vacuum likelihood inputs do not alter any statement independently of expansion inputs, separation is unnecessary.

accepted_gaps.title: No explicit observational-identifiability status for cosmic fate
accepted_gaps.testable_form: For each model family, compute whether accessible observables differ beyond predeclared predictive-check thresholds.
accepted_gaps.falsification_condition: If every retained model family is distinguishable by the declared data set, the unidentifiable status is unused.

accepted_gaps.title: Forecasts lack a pre-registered observable-to-fate decision rule
accepted_gaps.testable_form: Register model comparison, posterior-predictive, and future-discriminator rules before opening combined-probe results.
accepted_gaps.falsification_condition: If unconstrained exploratory model choice yields the same fate-status output with no additional error, preregistration has no effect.

accepted_gaps.title: Vacuum stability is not carried with its particle-physics sensitivity
accepted_gaps.testable_form: Propagate stated Higgs, top-mass, strong-coupling, and model-extension assumptions into an independent vacuum-status panel.
accepted_gaps.falsification_condition: If the vacuum-status classification is invariant under every stated uncertainty, its sensitivity analysis has no decision role.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Calculate one authoritative minimum number of years before universal death from the current age and Hubble rate.
rejected_candidates.reason: Rejected because it conflates unrelated endpoints and lacks a warranted asymptotic model.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Treat a reported low-redshift w0-wa preference as proof of a Big Rip.
rejected_candidates.reason: Rejected because the parametrization is not an automatically valid infinite-future continuation.
